lines: Press Start ride, and the plan takes the bike: every interval sets its own resistance.
Six fifty-two in, it is round one's recovery: one thirty-eight left, then thirty seconds of work at level twenty-four. A hundred and seven watts, on target.
Power versus plan draws every interval's target as a block, and your watts over it, up to six hundred.
With a video, it plays locked to the ride clock at your offset, above the plan's progress strip.
Raise, lower, or pick one of thirty-two levels. Sent to bike logs every command, and the next interval takes the plan back.
Flat resistance holds one level, level twelve, for the whole ride.
Start ride saves the workout to your account, so Custom workout opens on it next time. A plan Telo Ride refuses cannot start.
The custom ride, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
